cards.name: Chaos Moon
cards.oracleText: At the beginning of each upkeep, count the number of permanents. If the number is odd, until end of turn, red creatures get +1/+1 and whenever a player taps a Mountain for mana, that player adds an additional {R}. If the number is even, until end of turn, red creatures get -1/-1 and if a player taps a Mountain for mana, that Mountain produces colorless mana instead of any other type.

cards.name: Winter Moon
cards.oracleText: Players can't untap more than one nonbasic land during their untap steps.
